statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress is extreme because rates, oil and geopolitical supply risks remain elevated.
recommendation: Current mapping remains EA_ON because Tail is below the WATCH threshold; the elevated weekend uncertainty is represented primarily in Stress.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress during the closed weekend
body: NQ futures are closed, so no current one-way continuation, shallow-pullback or failed-retracement path can be observed. Friday finished with semiconductor-led Nasdaq strength but negative breadth, while Treasury yields above 5% and oil above $100 kept cross-asset stress high. Saudi supply disruption and Hormuz risk add weekend gap uncertainty without proving a pathological price path.

outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain a closed-market weekend window. Geopolitical, oil and rate risks can keep Stress extreme and alter reopening-gap expectations, but Tail remains low unless later price discovery shows persistent one-way continuation with weak or failed retracements. Verified U.S. macro and Fed checkpoints begin September 22.
